name: EntitySpec
lead: A kind of entity a pack makes up. `base` is the last argument of every hook: call it and you extended, don't and you replaced.

functions.name: on_spawn
functions.description: Told when one of this kind is spawned; nothing waits on it and its answer is not read.

functions.name: on_load
functions.description: Told when one that already existed comes back: a saved chunk loaded it or a reload rebound it.

functions.name: on_steer
functions.description: Runs before the physics each tick to decide where it goes; call `base(e)` to extend, leave it out to replace.

functions.name: on_tick
functions.description: Runs after the physics each tick to react to where it ended up; call `base(e)` to extend.

functions.name: on_think
functions.description: define only. The brain: one call for all due bodies of the kind, with their numbers in columns. The engine never waits for it; the answer lands on the next tick it is there, and is never dropped.

functions.name: on_damage
functions.signature: entitySpec.on_damage((e: EntityHandle, amount: number, by: Player ?) -> ("take" | "ignore")?) → ?
functions.description: Asked when a player hits it: answer "take" or "ignore". Nil or a missed deadline is "take". `by` is the player who hit.

functions.name: on_remove
functions.description: Told when it goes; `why` is "removed", "settled", "killed" or "unloaded". Not called when the pack goes away.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Your own word for the kind, lower case, digits and underscores; the pack's namespace is added for you ("rocket" is "rave:rocket").

fields.name: looks
fields.description: A shape the client draws, or a model from models.new.

fields.name: physics
fields.description: Which order of operations moves it: "living", "falling", "item", "none", or "vehicle" to drive by seat 1's keys.

fields.name: size
fields.description: One number, or { width, height }. An entity is as deep as it is wide.

fields.name: persist
fields.description: "save" brings it back with its chunk, `data` and all; "despawn", the default, is gone when the chunk goes.

fields.name: seats
fields.description: A model's: where riders sit (model units, seat 1 drives), its size, and what a client older than 1.21.4 sees.

fields.name: fallback
fields.description: What a client older than 1.21.4 sees in place of the model, such as "minecart".

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast it goes, in blocks a second. A vehicle's top speed; a living body's walk at forward = 1, the game's own mob walk by default.

fields.name: max_health
fields.description: physics = "living" only: the most health it has, and what it starts with. 1 to 1024; 20 by default.

fields.name: drops
fields.description: physics = "living" only: what it leaves when it dies. Each row is { item = "stick", count = 2 }, count = { least, most } for a random count, chance = 0.05 for a row that comes from one death in twenty, or a pack item. false or nil: nothing.

fields.name: sounds
fields.signature: entitySpec.sounds: ({ hurt: string ?, death: string ?, ambient: string ? } | false)?
fields.description: physics = "living" only: sound names for its hurt, its death and its idle sound, vanilla or "<pack>.<file>". false or nil: silent.

fields.name: can_fly
fields.description: physics = "living" only: it may fly when its pack sets e.flying = true, and it takes no fall damage.

fields.name: turn
fields.description: physics = "vehicle" only: degrees a second it turns at speed; 90 by default.

fields.name: accel
fields.description: physics = "vehicle" only: seconds from standing to top speed; 1 by default.

fields.name: step
fields.description: physics = "vehicle" only: blocks it climbs without a jump; 1 by default.

fields.name: think_every
fields.description: define only. Seconds between two thinks of one body; one tick (0.05) by default, at most 60. The engine spreads the bodies over the ticks.

title: EntitySpec type
